questions: Did these movements begin suddenly, within minutes or hours?
Did they begin within the past few days?
Are the movements confined mainly to one side of the body?
Is the face involved on that same side?
Did you develop weakness or numbness on one side at the same time?
Did you develop difficulty speaking, understanding speech, seeing, walking, or maintaining balance?
Did you develop a sudden severe headache, vomiting, or loss of consciousness?
Have you remained fully aware during the movements?
Do the movements stop completely when you sleep?
Can you briefly suppress or voluntarily control them?
Have you had a recent head injury?
Do you have diabetes?
Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
Have you previously had a stroke or transient ischemic attack?
Do you have high blood pressure, high cholesterol, atrial fibrillation, or other vascular disease?
Have you started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication recently?
Are you taking levodopa, an antipsychotic, an antidepressant, an anticonvulsant, or a stimulant?
Have you used cocaine, amphetamines, or other recreational drugs recently?
Have you had fever, a recent infection, or inflammation?
Are you pregnant or within six months after giving birth?
Have you had similar involuntary movements previously?
Do close relatives have Huntington disease or similar progressive involuntary movements?
Have the movements been progressively worsening over weeks or months rather than starting suddenly?
Have you had unexplained weight loss, night sweats, or a known cancer?
